resource: Interval between periodic World highscore snapshots
allocation_impact: One job per World publishes all 11 categories in one repeatable-read cut when the oldest current snapshot is 30 minutes old (database time, durable across restart) or on a planned reset; between passes the job sleeps until the earliest durable expiry. No client command can start a pass.
boundary_tests: a cut younger than 30 minutes is skipped and the next check is scheduled at its durable expiry
a planned reset publishes a complete cut regardless of age
